title: Larkspur Credit Cards Schedule of Annual and Transaction Fees
content:
The annual fee and transaction fees of the Larkspur Credit Cards vary by card as set out below. Dollar amounts are in USD. Percentages apply to the amount of each transaction, except the cash advance limit, which is a percentage of the credit limit.

## Fees by card

| Fee term | Larkspur Secured Visa | Larkspur Classic Visa | Larkspur Cash Back Visa | Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum | Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature | Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Annual fee (charged in the billing cycle of each account anniversary) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 95 | 95 |
| First annual fee not charged | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |
| Balance transfer fee, percent of each transfer | not offered | 5 | 5 | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Minimum balance transfer fee | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Cash advance fee, percent of each advance | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Minimum cash advance fee | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Cash advance limit, percent of the credit limit | 10 | 20 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Foreign transaction fee, percent of each transaction processed outside the United States | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| Over-limit fee | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Notes to the schedule

- **Balance transfers on the secured card.** "Not offered" means transfers are not allowed on the Larkspur Secured Visa. Its minimum balance transfer fee of 5 is a listed term with no transfer to apply to.
- **Over-limit fee.** The over-limit fee is 0 on every card, because transactions over the limit are declined instead.
- **Annual fee waiver.** Only the two Visa Signature cards charge an annual fee (95). On both, the first annual fee is not charged.
- **Foreign transactions.** The two Visa Signature cards charge 0 percent on transactions processed outside the United States. Every other card charges 3 percent.

## Hypothetical reading of the cash advance limit

The credit limit here is invented. On an account with a credit limit of 1,000.00:

| Card | Cash advance limit percent | Cash advance limit |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Secured Visa | 10 | 100.00 |
| Larkspur Classic Visa | 20 | 200.00 |
| Any of the other four cards | 30 | 300.00 |
